evidence.reason: In main(), --report is written only after build() succeeds, and the code never compares it with --output, the provenance path, or the .sha256 sidecar. Therefore --report equal to --output overwrites the verified archive with report JSON and still exits 0; the same collision can overwrite the provenance file. This is an ordinary destructive input-collision defect, and rejecting the collision before build() is the smallest compatible fix.
